response.sql:
WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
), total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_order_count
  FROM Orders
)
SELECT coc.customer_id,
       coc.order_count,
       1.0 * coc.order_count / NULLIF(t.total_order_count, 0) AS order_share
FROM customer_order_counts AS coc
CROSS JOIN total_orders AS t
ORDER BY order_share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Share uses every row in Orders as the denominator; customers with no orders are excluded because their share is zero and do not rank among the top 10 when orders exist. If there are no orders, no customer rows are returned.
